title: Weekend Zoo Trip
instructions: Work with a partner. Do not show your sheet! Ask questions to fill in every missing word.
taggedSource:
On [A:Saturday], Maya and her brother go to the [B:city] zoo by [A:train]. First, they see two tall [B:giraffes] eating green [A:leaves].

At [B:twelve] o'clock, they eat cheese [A:sandwiches] under a big [B:tree] and watch the [A:penguins] swim.
helperA:
When do Maya and her brother go to the zoo? (Answer: Saturday)
How do they travel to the zoo? (Answer: by train)
What do the giraffes eat? (Answer: green leaves)
What do Maya and her brother eat for lunch? (Answer: cheese sandwiches)
Which animals do they watch swimming? (Answer: penguins)
helperB:
Which zoo do they visit? (Answer: city zoo)
Which tall animals do they see first? (Answer: giraffes)
What time do they eat lunch? (Answer: twelve o'clock)
Where do they sit to eat lunch? (Answer: under a big tree)

title: The Mountain Train Trip
instructions: Work in pairs. Ask your partner for the missing times, prices, and places to complete the travel notes.
taggedSource:

Passengers can buy hot [B:tea] and fresh muffins in carriage [A:three], or book a guided [B:waterfall] walk at the village office.
helperA:

title: Two Pen Pals
instructions: Each student is missing facts about either Hannah or Kenji. Ask clear questions to complete both profiles.
taggedSource:

Her pen pal Kenji lives near [A:Kyoto] and collects vintage [B:postcards]. Next August, Kenji plans to visit Ireland for [A:two] weeks with his [B:cousin].

title: The Old Lighthouse Archive
instructions: Discuss the historical discovery with your partner to recover all missing facts.
taggedSource:

Each ledger recorded wind [A:direction], passing [B:steamships], and rare migratory birds spotted off the [A:eastern] cliffs. Historians are now digitizing the pages for a free [B:online] exhibition.
helperA:
What metal was the hidden box made of? (Answer: copper)
In what format were the weather journals written? (Answer: handwritten)
Besides ships and birds, what weather detail was logged? (Answer: wind direction)
Off which cliffs were migratory birds spotted? (Answer: eastern cliffs)
helperB:
Where was the box hidden inside the lighthouse? (Answer: beneath a loose floorboard)
